title: Evaluation of a circuit tail
statement: Let a circuit tail have $m$ available inputs, assign a sign in $\{-1,1\}$ to each input, and choose an initial gate type, AND or OR. For an output layer, evaluate its designated inputs using that gate. For a non-output layer, evaluate each gate in the layer on its designated inputs, then evaluate the remaining tail on those gate outputs using the dual gate.
hypotheses_covered: Each input is assigned a sign in $\{-1,1\}$
An initial gate type is chosen from AND and OR
